name: Teasing
overview: Scripture teaches that speech must be governed by truth and respect, forbidding false witness and reviling of parents as serious offenses (Exodus 20:16; 21:17). Teasing, often rooted in froward or harmful words, contrasts with the righteous who speak what is acceptable (Proverbs 10:32). The wisdom literature warns against careless or malicious speech that can ignite conflict and destruction, likening it to a madman casting firebrands (Proverbs 26:18). Faithfulness in speech involves discretion and guarding secrets, opposing the behavior of talebearers who reveal what should be concealed (Proverbs 11:13).
